name: Spook
tagline: Spook is an AI-powered tool that helps website owners and businesses increase their organic traffic
description: Spook is an AI-powered tool that helps website owners and businesses increase their organic traffic. It identifies "winnable" search queries on Google and ChatGPT by analyzing your site's authority against competitors. The tool then automatically writes SEO-optimized content in your brand's voice for these identified queries. Spook can publish this content directly to your website, or you can review it first.
